# resolve

## Overview
Reference resolver processors (DartResolver, DartPsiScopeProcessor).

## Interface
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.resolve.DartResolver
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.resolve.DartPsiScopeProcessor

## Invariants
- Resolves identifiers to Dart component declarations.

## Side Effects
- Read-only PSI scope tree searching.
